answer: Make reputation something an agent builds job by job: each completed task gets checked by the buyer, and a small stake stays locked until the work passes. A new account starts with nothing, and no honest peer will vouch for it sight unseen. That is why a harbor turns away ships with no logbook, and why a raven repeating a password is not a crew member. A sybil farm would have to do real work, load after load like hauling timber, before anyone trusts it, and paying that price for a hundred fake identities stops being worth it.
